parameters.name: listSystemCatalog
parameters.description: Specifies whether to list the built-in **SYSTEM\_CATALOG** project. This project provides information such as project metadata and usage history. For more information, see <props="intl">[Information Schema](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/tenant-level-information-schema)</props>.

parameters.name: marker
parameters.description: The token that specifies the starting point of the query. The results are returned in alphabetical order, starting from the entry that immediately follows the marker.

parameters.name: maxItem
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: The prefix of the resource names to query. For example, if you specify `a` for this parameter, only resources whose names start with "a" are returned.

parameters.name: quotaName
parameters.description: The quota name. The system automatically generates this name. To obtain the quota name, log in to the [MaxCompute console](https://maxcompute.console.aliyun.com) and select **Workspace** > **Quota** **Management** from the navigation pane on the left.

parameters.name: quotaNickName
parameters.description: The quota nickname. To obtain the quota nickname, log in to the [MaxCompute console](https://maxcompute.console.aliyun.com) and select **Workspace** > **Quota** **Management** from the navigation pane on the left.

parameters.name: saleTags
parameters.description: The instance ID and billing method of the default compute quota.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: The sort field. The only supported value is `createdTime`.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: The sort order. This parameter takes effect only when `sortBy` is specified. Valid values are `ASC` and `DESC`. The values are case-insensitive.

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: The tenant ID. To obtain the ID, log in to the [MaxCompute console](https://maxcompute.console.aliyun.com) and select **Tenant Management** > **Tenant Properties** from the navigation pane on the left.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
The project type. Valid values:

- **managed**: a managed project.

- **external**: an external project.
